summary: Plaintiff counsel first raised fees in an opening term sheet, and the parties negotiated fees alongside class relief before reaching a binding deal. Hargrove Lane’s private reasoning sought a larger fee as well as a larger class fund. The transcript does not show a fee-for-relief tradeoff, defense exploitation of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
